contracts.name: press_button
contracts.label: Press button or switch
contracts.description: Walk to one exact reachable button, switch or other native control and activate it. Safely park held cargo first.
start_preconditions: An exact native activation target with a verified walking route; on/off requires a readable toggle state.
contracts.completion_evidence: The selected control acknowledges Player 2’s native trigger, or its observed toggle already reaches the requested on/off state.
contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; a committed activation cannot be undone.
limitations: One activation per task. Press/click/push defaults to trigger; on/off binds a requested state.
Never substitutes another control. Routes and native interaction gates are rechecked before pressing. Unknown routes are not offered to Jev.
No timed holds, pressure plates, menus, or claims about downstream machinery.

contracts.name: assemble_dish
contracts.label: Assemble assigned dish
contracts.description: Produce one exact live ticket using only allocated bases, component instances and equipment; mixing/cooking follow its native recipe.
start_preconditions: A live supported recipe ticket; compatible allocated plate and explicit resources.
contracts.completion_evidence: Exact selected plate composition and native plating step match the original live ticket.
contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; committed physical effects are not rolled back.
limitations: No chopping, dispenser replacements, plate washing, serving, automatic next order, gap transport or optional/unknown recipe branches.
Allocation binds exact objects; bases are alternatives. Clean stacks pin their current top plate. Missing resources wait; they never permit substitution.

contracts.name: prepare_near_player
contracts.label: Prepare and give to player
contracts.description: Prepare each requested ingredient/utensil quantity and deliver it near another eligible local player.
start_preconditions: An eligible recipient and obtainable ingredient or utensil; preparation and handoff require native work/compatibility/route checks.
contracts.completion_evidence: Every entry quantity delivered with native cargo identity and handoff evidence; finite totals equal quantity times repetitions.
contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; committed physical effects are not rolled back.
limitations: Raw preserves the exact root; processed states follow its native work chain. Empty applies to utensils/plates.
A state name alone does not prove a cooking/mixing recipe or compatible equipment. No concurrent high-level jobs.

contracts.completion_evidence: One ready food collection and verified serving/parking.
contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; committed physical effects are not rolled back.

contracts.completion_evidence: Native sink becomes empty after washing the selected batch.
contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; committed physical effects are not rolled back.
limitations: One repetition is a batch, not one plate.

contracts.label: Deliver dirty dishes

contracts.cancellation: Stop cancels and neutralizes owned input; committed physical effects are not rolled back.

contracts.name: navigate_to
contracts.label: Navigate
contracts.description: Walk to a registered station/object, physical platform or floor position, without interacting. Directional destinations use observed camera-oriented spatial context.
start_preconditions: Fresh registered destination in the current kitchen and one P2 owner. Blocked or unknown routes wait with neutral input until a native checked route exists.
contracts.completion_evidence: Stable arrival at the exact station approach or registered support-local point, on the correct support and height layer. No work, pickup, placement or cargo manipulation.
contracts.cancellation: Stop neutralizes input and cancels waiting or walking; suspension preserves the binding.
limitations: A finite repositioning only; persistent area assignments are unsupported.
No invented coordinates or predicted future crossings. Incomplete coverage remains unknown.
